title: Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets
summary: Determine whether the array positions can be split into exactly k nonempty groups with equal sums.

contractDetails.constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ length(nums) ≤ 16. Values lie in [1,10000]. Each distinct value appears at most four times.
contractDetails.output-checking: Compare boolean feasibility of partitioning all positions into k nonempty equal-sum groups.

statement: Determine whether the array positions can be split into exactly k nonempty groups with equal sums. A position belongs to one group. Group members need not be adjacent.

examples.explanation: Each group can contain one 2 and one 3.
The target is 5, and the value 4 has no partner that can complete it.
The only position forms the only group.

constraints: 1 ≤ k ≤ length(nums) ≤ 16. Values lie in [1,10000]. Each distinct value appears at most four times.
hints: Conceptual: The common sum is fixed by the total and k.
Directional: Track the positions already used and how full the current group is.
Implementation: Use a bitmask for used positions. Extend reachable states without exceeding the target, resetting the load to zero whenever a group is filled.
complexityAnalysis: O(n × 2^n) time and O(2^n) auxiliary space.
